company_search.description: Find companies (and people) by ticker or name: cik, name, tickers (EDGAR's search-box index).

submissions.description: A company's filing history: one row per filing (form, filingDate, reportDate, accessionNumber, primaryDocument, url), newest first; profile columns cik, entity_name, sic.

cik.desc: CIK number (any length; zero-padded to 10 digits)

ticker.desc: ticker (AAPL, BRK-B) or company name; resolved to a CIK with EDGAR's company search

forms.desc: comma-separated forms to keep, e.g. '10-K,10-Q' (amendments 10-K/A kept only if listed)

since.desc: keep filings on or after YYYY-MM-DD

all.desc: true = also read the older-filings files (filings.files); otherwise the latest 1,000 or so

company_concept.description: Every value one company reported for one XBRL concept: one row per fact (start, end, period_days, val, unit, fy, fp, form, filed, accn, frame).

cik.desc: CIK number (any length; zero-padded to 10 digits)

ticker.desc: ticker (AAPL, BRK-B) or company name; resolved to a CIK with EDGAR's company search

tag.desc: XBRL concept, e.g. NetIncomeLoss, Revenues, Assets (case-sensitive)

unit.desc: unit to keep: USD, shares, USD/shares, pure (default: all); USD-per-shares is accepted and sent as USD/shares

forms.desc: comma-separated forms to keep, e.g. '10-K' (prefix match: 10-K keeps 10-K/A)

frames_only.desc: true = one value per period: the framed fact, or the latest filed when SEC gave a period of the series' own length (annual, quarter, instant) no frame; other lengths (YTD) are skipped

duration.desc: annual (350-380 days) or quarter (80-100 days): keep duration facts of that length (period_days column); instant facts are dropped

company_facts.description: Every XBRL fact a company reported, all concepts: one row per fact with taxonomy and tag columns (large: tens of thousands of rows for big filers; set tags).

cik.desc: CIK number (any length; zero-padded to 10 digits)

ticker.desc: ticker (AAPL, BRK-B) or company name; resolved to a CIK with EDGAR's company search

unit.desc: unit to keep: USD, shares, USD/shares, pure (default: all); USD-per-shares is accepted and sent as USD/shares

frames_only.desc: true = one value per period: the framed fact, or the latest filed when SEC gave a period of the series' own length (annual, quarter, instant) no frame; other lengths (YTD) are skipped

duration.desc: annual (350-380 days) or quarter (80-100 days): keep duration facts of that length (period_days column); instant facts are dropped

frames.description: One concept for every reporting company in one calendar period: one row per company (cik, entityName, loc, start, end, val, accn).

unit.desc: USD (default), shares, USD-per-shares, pure; USD/shares is accepted and sent as USD-per-shares

full_text_search.description: EDGAR full-text search (2001-): one row per matching DOCUMENT (a filing's main file and each exhibit are separate hits): adsh, form, file_date, entity, file_type, url.

q.desc: words; quote phrases: '"climate risk"'; AND/OR/NOT supported

insider_filings.description: Insider ownership filings (Form 4 by default; 3, 5) where the company is the issuer: one row per filing with insider name and CIK, filing and period dates, link.

cik.desc: CIK number (any length; zero-padded to 10 digits)

ticker.desc: ticker (AAPL, BRK-B) or company name; resolved to a CIK with EDGAR's company search

concepts.NetIncomeLoss: Net income (loss) attributable to the parent
concepts.Liabilities: Total liabilities (instant; not reported by every filer)
concepts.EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding: dei: shares outstanding on the cover page
